lines.text: Paul tells the Colossians to keep walking in Christ, rooted, built up, established in the faith, and overflowing with thankfulness.
Paul warns against empty deception based on human tradition, and says believers are made complete in Christ, head over every ruler and authority.
Paul says believers were circumcised in Christ, putting off their earthly wealth, by a circumcision performed not by human hands.
Buried with Christ in baptism, believers were raised through faith in God's power, and God made them alive and forgave some of their trespasses.
Christ canceled the debt against us, nailing it to the cross, and disarmed the powers and authorities, triumphing over them.
